ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: left figure a represents monthly inflow water volume; in January—May, the inflow water volume is generally relatively small, and in July—September it clearly increases and reaches a peak; right figure b represents monthly average water level, and the reservoir water level gradually decreases from the beginning of the year, reaches the lowest of the whole year in May, and then gradually rises again. Reasoning: because the figure shows that flood-season incoming water is mainly concentrated in July—September, before the flood season arrives the reservoir needs to lower the water level in advance and actively release water, in order to make enough room in reservoir capacity, facilitating impounding floodwater and flood prevention during the flood season. Therefore, the lowest water level appears in May.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：a图中入库水量在7—9月明显增大，5月前后较低；b图中月均水位在5月达到最低。再看题干：问的是“为什么5月份最低水位”。把两图联系起来，可知水库在汛前主动降低水位，通过放水腾出防洪库容，以便汛期来水时拦蓄洪水。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左图a表示逐月入库水量，1—5月入库水量总体较少，7—9月明显增大并达到高峰；右图b表示月均水位，水库水位从年初逐渐下降，在5月份达到全年最低，之后又逐渐升高。推理：由于图中显示汛期来水主要集中在7—9月，水库在汛期到来之前需要提前降低水位，主动放水，以腾出足够库容，便于汛期拦蓄洪水、防洪。因此5月份出现最低水位。
